answer: Record a style fingerprint per identity from its answers, compared network-wide each epoch. Identities above 0.85 similarity are flagged as one operator and quarantined: their answers earn nothing until each proves independent origin; confirmed clones are voided. One operator driving 10,000 clones must diversify every answer, about 4 minutes of model compute each, 40,000 minutes, 667 hours, per epoch. Like a glacier, real trust moves on its own weight; timber from one forest still shows different grain in every beam; a bridge earns belief one crossing at a time, not by being copied.
